clauses.description: modules/widget-v2/ contains package.json, tsconfig.json, and vitest.config.ts. `npm install && npm test` (run with cwd modules/widget-v2) executes Vitest under the jsdom environment and exits 0 (green) with at least one passing test asserting the wire.ts barrel.
clauses.acceptance_sketch_ref: modules/widget-v2/package.json + tsconfig.json + vitest.config.ts; npm test runs Vitest+jsdom green

verification.command: npm --prefix modules/widget-v2 ci && npm --prefix modules/widget-v2 test
verification.expected_outcome: Vitest runs in jsdom env, all tests pass, exit code 0

clauses.description: The Vitest jsdom environment provides working test shims for crypto.subtle (WebCrypto SubtleCrypto), LocalStorage, and IndexedDB so test code referencing those browser globals does not throw ReferenceError. A setup file wires these into globalThis before each test file.
clauses.acceptance_sketch_ref: jsdom env with crypto.subtle/LocalStorage/IndexedDB shims for tests

verification.expected_outcome: A shim test asserts typeof crypto.subtle.digest === 'function', localStorage get/set round-trips, and indexedDB.open is callable; all pass

clauses.description: A single modules/widget-v2/src/wire.ts re-exports the full SPEC-CRWDQ-017 wire surface: Envelope, every *Payload type, the 20-value MessageType, CHANNELS, canonicalChannel, parseLine, buildEnvelope, serialize, and the 7 WireError codes. wire.ts is the only module owning these symbols (no duplicate hand-rolled parser/types elsewhere in widget-v2).
clauses.acceptance_sketch_ref: single src/wire.ts re-exports Envelope, all *Payload types, 20-value MessageType, CHANNELS, canonicalChannel, parseLine/buildEnvelope/serialize, 7 WireError codes from SPEC-CRWDQ-017

verification.expected_outcome: A barrel test imports from src/wire.ts and asserts: MessageType has 20 values, CHANNELS contains 'control' and 'game_data', canonicalChannel pins the 5 game_data types correctly, parseLine/buildEnvelope/serialize round-trip an Envelope, and 7 distinct WireError codes are exported (malformed_frame, unknown_channel, unknown_message_type, unpinned_channel, unsupported_schema_version, missing_seq, unexpected_seq)

clauses.description: An ESLint lint gate and a TypeScript type-check (tsc --noEmit) gate are runnable as npm scripts and pass clean against the widget-v2 source + tests.

verification.command: npm --prefix modules/widget-v2 run lint && npm --prefix modules/widget-v2 run typecheck

verification.expected_outcome: No matches: no @latest, no bare '*' version specifiers in dependencies/devDependencies

in_scope: TypeScript toolchain scaffold under modules/widget-v2 (package.json, tsconfig.json, vitest.config.ts, eslint config, build config)
jsdom test environment + setup file with crypto.subtle/LocalStorage/IndexedDB shims
single src/wire.ts barrel re-exporting the SPEC-CRWDQ-017 wire surface
ESLint + tsc typecheck npm scripts and CI gate
additive, path-scoped Node CI job in .github/workflows/ci.yml
v2 bundle entry point + build script
out_of_scope: Any render template (single_game, fixtures, ads, etc.)
Modifying v1 crowdaq-widget.xml or the existing PHP CI jobs
Backend authorship of SPEC-CRWDQ-017 itself (this is the player-side consumer barrel)
assumptions: SPEC-CRWDQ-017 lives in crowdaq-backend (TypeScript) and is NOT an installable npm dependency of xibo-plugin; therefore wire.ts vendors a faithful in-repo copy of the SPEC-CRWDQ-017 wire surface (envelope/types/parser/errors) matching the contract referenced by SPEC-CRWDQ-022, rather than importing from a published package. If the Evaluator requires importing from a real package path instead, that is a contract change.
The 20 MessageType values and 7 WireError codes are exactly those enumerated in SPEC-CRWDQ-022 (16 server->player + 4 player->server types; the 7 ParseErrorReason codes).
Node 20.x toolchain consistent with the existing CI (setup-node 20.17.0).
Bundler choice (tsup/esbuild/rollup) is left to the implementer provided it is version-pinned and produces a single dist entry.

test_strategy.approach: Real in-repo implementation under test via src/wire.ts; barrel + round-trip tests call the real functions, no mocks (INV-FACTORY-16/17 style).
jsdom environment + a vitest setup file installing Node WebCrypto (globalThis.crypto.subtle), an in-memory Storage shim, and fake-indexeddb; asserted by a shim smoke test.
Pinned devDependencies; executed directly via npm scripts in tests and in the additive CI job.
Additive path-scoped Node job; verified by inspecting the workflow diff (PHP jobs unchanged) rather than executing Actions locally.
